resources.string: Teleport on the map — with one tap
Tap the map to pick a place

1. Settings → About phone
2. Tap MIUI version 7 times (Developer options will turn on; on other phones tap Build number)
3. Developer options → Select mock location app
4. Choose Fake GPS
5. Come back, pick a place and press Start
Location permission is needed — allow it, otherwise Start will not work. (Settings → Apps → Fake GPS → Permissions → Location)
The app is not selected as the mock location app — set it up first, otherwise teleport will not work.

The app uses Android\'s official mock location system. It works in Google Maps and WhatsApp, but apps that detect mock locations will detect this too. After a phone restart you need to turn it on again.
